title: Figure 11: Cone-tainer seedling pots and racks for seed germination experiment
description: Color product-style photograph of two black plastic racks filled with rows of tan tube-shaped "cone-tainer" pots, with several loose cone-tainers lying in front. The caption reads "Figure 11 - Example of Cone-tainers and associated racks." It illustrates the "Seed Experiment" section describing a germination and growth comparison using Stokes Sugar Snap Peas and Stokes Green Beans at BAASS and ranch locations set up on April 22, 2010.
